Δημήτρης Κόψης

Παρασκευή 4 Δεκεμβρίου στις 21:30 | EXA

EXA at night—the lights are right, the air has clarity, there's a sense that something genuine might happen here. Δημήτρης Κόψης takes the stage with an instrument list that makes sense: what he's about to do requires precision, and precision requires honest tools.

Κόψης is a musician first, genre second. His work sits somewhere between jazz sensibility and contemporary music training, which means everything he plays has both structure and surprise. The improvisation is informed. The composition is flexible. He respects the audience enough to risk failing in front of them.

This is performance that understands technical skill as liberation, not limitation. The better the musician, the more freedom for genuine expression.

You'll find serious musicians here, people who follow contemporary Greek performance, people who read the programmer's taste and came because of it. The crowd respects what Κόψης is attempting. That respect creates permission to go into uncomfortable places.

The set builds through pieces that introduce his world. Early songs establish the instrumental language. Middle section explores implications—you hear where the tradition came from and where it wants to go. Final sequences are often improvisational, which is where the real conversation happens. The audience becomes sounding board for what emerges.
